subject: Breach-notif scenarios, SOC 2 status & BCP/IR evidence request
messages:
From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
To: Jane Park <jane.park@everwell.health>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 9 Dec 2025 15:02:00 -0800
Subject: Breach-notif scenarios, SOC 2 status & BCP/IR evidence request

Hi Jane —

Thanks again for taking time today. Quick recap from our call and the items we agreed to follow up on for Everwell's security/compliance review: 

- SOC 2: you asked whether we have a Type II report and what the most recent coverage dates are.
- Incident response & notification timelines: you wanted example timelines for a contained data exposure vs. a customer-impacting breach, including escalation points and notification windows.
- BCP/DR evidence: Everwell needs RTO/RPO tables and a high-level playbook we can share with your risk team.
- Vendor questionnaire: you indicated you'll send the security questionnaire (vendor intake) and asked for a point of contact for separate evidence uploads.

Attached are the items we think will help immediately: a SOC 2 snapshot (summary of scope & dates), an IR playbook summary, and an RTO/RPO table. I also included a blank copy of the vendor-security-questionnaire in case you want us to pre-fill it and upload to your portal.

High-level answers to the specific items from the call:
- SOC 2: We maintain a SOC 2 Type II covering the inference platform and control plane; most recent audit period ended 2024-11-30. Full Type II report is available under NDA — we can provide via secure portal or DocuSign-protected link.
- IR & breach notif: Standard notification windows are: 24 hours initial detection acknowledgment to the customer security contact, 72 hours detailed assessment and scope, and 7 days for a recommended remediation plan. We can tighten SLAs contractually for enterprise customers.
- BCP/DR: Typical RTO for our control plane is under 4 hours for critical APIs, and RPO is generally under 15 minutes for active KV caches; on-prem/private deployments vary by customer config — see attached RTO/RPO table.

Next steps I propose:
1) Please send your vendor questionnaire (or confirm you want us to pre-fill the attached template).
2) If you need the full SOC 2 Type II, indicate preferred delivery method (secure portal or DocuSign link) and we will share the NDA & report.
3) We'll schedule a 30-min follow-up with our IR lead (Neha) tomorrow to walk your security team through the playbook and notification timelines.

If that plan looks good I can get Neha on the calendar — available windows: Wed 10 Dec 09:00-11:30 PT or 14:00-16:00 PT.

Thanks,

-- 
Priyom Das
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
priyom.das@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0143
[Attachment: SOC2-snapshot-Redwood-2024.pdf (PDF, 1.1MB)]
[Attachment: IR-playbook-summary.docx (DOCX, 220KB)]
[Attachment: BCP-RTO-RPO-table.xlsx (XLSX, 45KB)]
[Attachment: vendor-security-questionnaire.xlsx (XLSX, 120KB)]
From: Jane Park <jane.park@everwell.health>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@everwell.health>, security@everwell.health, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 9 Dec 2025 17:08:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Breach-notif scenarios, SOC 2 status & BCP/IR evidence request

Thanks for the clear recap, Priyom — appreciated. Quick clarifications from our side: 

1) We will need the full SOC 2 Type II report; delivery via secure portal is preferred. Please start the NDA flow.
2) For incident notification, could you provide two scenario timelines: (A) limited exposure — internal-only, no PHI; (B) cross-tenant exposure involving PHI. For (B) we need a faster external notification cadence and a draft customer communication template.
3) RTO/RPO table looks helpful; legal will need evidence of tabletop exercises and last test dates.

I'll share our vendor-security-questionnaire by EOD. Our procurement/legal team will require references and a copy of your insurance (cyber liability) summary as well.

Also, very important: Everwell is HIPAA-regulated and will require Business Associate Agreement (BAA) terms to be discussed if PHI is in scope. Please loop in your contracts lead if BAA negotiation is required.

Tom and I are available for the IR walkthrough on Wed 10 Dec at 10:30 PT if that works for Neha.

Best,

--
Jane Park
Chief Security & Privacy Officer | Everwell Health
jane.park@everwell.health
From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
To: Jane Park <jane.park@everwell.health>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@everwell.health>
Date: Wed, 10 Dec 2025 08:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Breach-notif scenarios, SOC 2 status & BCP/IR evidence request

Jane — thanks, and understood on HIPAA/BAA. Quick replies inline and a few asks so we can prepare the right artifacts for legal & procurement: 

- SOC 2 delivery: we'll open the secure portal share and send an NDA today. Our security ops team will provision a view-only link to the full Type II within 24 hours of NDA completion.

- IR scenarios: Neha will present two scenario timelines and a draft external notification template at the Wed 10:30 PT meeting. For the PHI scenario we'll include the escalation path for legal, privacy, and customer communications.

- Tabletop evidence: we ran a tabletop in 2025-08, with the next scheduled for 2026-02. We'll attach the tabletop summary and action items; if procurement needs certified test reports we can provide the facilitator notes and attendee roster.

- Insurance: I'll ask our finance/insurance lead to share a cyber liability summary (redacted policy number) into the portal.

- BAA: Marissa (CC'd) is our contracts lead and will connect with Everwell's legal counsel to discuss BAA terms and timelines. Marissa — can you lead the BAA conversation and propose a redline window (we typically turn around initial redlines within 3 business days)?

Finally, two small requests from procurement: can you confirm the preferred evidence upload method (your secure portal vs. vendor portal link)? If you prefer us to pre-fill the vendor questionnaire, attach the completed XLSX to the portal and we'll flag the cells with commentary.

I'll send calendar invites for 10:30 PT with a short pre-read (IR scenarios + SOC 2 share instructions).

Thanks,

--
Priyom Das
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
priyom.das@redwood.com
[Inline: we'll upload the SOC2 link to the portal after NDA completion]
From: Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@everwell.health>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Jane Park <jane.park@everwell.health>, security@everwell.health
Date: Wed, 10 Dec 2025 09:18:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Breach-notif scenarios, SOC 2 status & BCP/IR evidence request

Appreciate the quick turnaround. 10:30 PT works for us. A couple of requests before the walkthrough: 

- Please include a slide that enumerates notification triggers (detection thresholds, data sensitivity decision tree).
- On the PHI scenario, include the expected customer communication cadence (initial ack, follow-up summary, final remediation report) with sample language.
- For the tabletop evidence, a one-page summary with dates, exercises run, and attendees is sufficient for procurement.

We'll send the vendor questionnaire within the hour to security@redwood.com (please confirm the address for uploads).

See you at 10:30.

Tom
Director of Procurement | Everwell Health

> Priyom — thanks. Upload the SOC2 and insurance summary to the portal. We'll review the materials ahead of the walkthrough.

> Jane
